sentences.text: This hard hat exists because of a war.
In World War One, soldiers wore steel helmets shaped like bowls.
When Edward Bullard came home, he noticed miners had nothing protecting their heads.
So in nineteen nineteen, in his father's shop, he steamed layers of canvas, glued them together, and painted them black.
He called it the Hard Boiled Hat.
And in nineteen thirty-three, the Golden Gate Bridge became America's first official Hard Hat Area.
